name: ukphonebook.com

search.notes: GET form on the home page with fields name and location. Location also accepts a postcode. Some results need paid credits to view in full.

steps: Open the Record Removal Request Form on ukphonebook.com.
Enter forename and surname exactly as listed.
Enter the address and postcode of the listed record.
Enter an email address and, if wanted, a phone number so the site can follow up.
Submit the form. Fill in one form per person and per address.
Check the listing again after 2 working days.
optout.notes: The help page says online forms take up to 2 working days. A printed form can be posted to Simunix Ltd, Middleham House, 2-3 St. Marys Court, York YO24 1AH and takes up to 28 days. The site shows the edited (open) electoral register, so also do gb-open-register. Google may keep showing name and postcode district until it recrawls.

verification_note: Removal form and help FAQ loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21. FAQ describes the online and postal removal process and timelines.
